text_block_list.text:
In the cafeteria, I spotted Taiki Shuttle 
and Seeking the Pearl.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
If I'm going to conquer the world someday, 
I have to master English, French, and 
languages from every country!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Oh! You are going to become multilingual, 
yes!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Yes! A master of gab!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
However, even if you don't master it 
perfectly, body language surprisingly gets 
the job done!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Huh... The words might differ, but 
expressing your feelings is universal! The 
world truly is full of possibilities!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"Taiki! Why don't we try having a 
conversation using only body language and 
the word 'Revolution'?"

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Let's clash our passions together using 
simple words and full-body emotional 
expression!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Wow! Sounds interesting! Okay, let's do 
it!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Revolution?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Oh! Revolution!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Rev-o-lution! Rev-o-lution!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Fufu, revolution☆

They look like they're really having a 
lively conversation, but I can't 
understand a single word of it...
choice_data_list: Um, what are you guys talking about?
Um, what are you talking about?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Oh? Did my body language and vocal 
inflection not get the message across?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Here's how the conversation starts— "Which 
do you like better, the Northern 
Hemisphere or the Southern Hemisphere?"

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"And then she went, 'Northern Hemisphere,' 
right? So since I'm from there too, I 
replied, 'What a coincidence! I'll aim for 
world conquest starting with the Northern 
Hemisphere.'"

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Oh!? I thought I was being invited to a 
house party, so I said yes!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
She said she "can't wait for delicious 
food," so I told her, "I'll treat you to a 
barbecue☆!"

It seems neither of the other two 
understood what was going on either...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Taking wing into the world really is no 
easy feat.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Weeell... is it difficult using just body 
language, I wonder?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I understand desu! Next time, let's do it 
with "muffins"!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Muffin!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Muffin!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Muffin! Muffin!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: A muf~fin~?
choice_data_list: So what did you talk about this time?
What did you talk about this time?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
First, I declared, "I shall conquer the 
world!"

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I knew it!! I answered, "I can definitely 
do it!", desu!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
To which I replied, 'Thank you! Make sure 
to come to the victory party!'!!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: I asked, "What should I wear~?"!!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Whoo!! We did it!! We are completely in 
sync now!!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Yes!! With this, we're one step closer to 
world domination!!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
I'm certain of it!! Muffins can take over 
the world!! Thanks for coming up with the 
idea!

I have no idea how that counted as a 
conversation, but I felt like I was shown 
a glimpse of potential.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
“Not necessary...? Does that mean we 
communicate solely through body language, 
yes?”

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
I see, half-hearted words only end up 
becoming mere noise, right!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Yeees! That bold idea is world-class! 
Let's start our body-language talk right 
away!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Okay! *Huff*... *puff*...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: *Haah*... *phew*...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Wow! Awesome! Hah...! Hoh...!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Yes! I can feel your passion! How about 
this, then!? Hah...!

It's unclear if it even counts as a 
conversation, but the two poured their 
hearts out at each other with everything 
they had.
